name: Puxian
confidence_why: One first-hand description, checked against the source; 3 other works consulted do not discuss stress.
catalog_citation: Wu, Jianming. 2010. The Function of Pronominal Expressions in Puxian. PhD thesis, Lancaster University, Department of Linguistics and English Language. Open copy via CORE/Lancaster E-Prints:https://core.ac.uk/download/9665697.pdf
catalog_quote: In addition, Puxian is a tone language, which is noteworthy for complex tone sandhi phenomena. There are 7 tones, as shown in Table 3. ... Tone sandhi occurs when two monosyllabic lexemes join together. There are about 49 tone sandhi combinations used in daily speech (Cai Guomei 2006: 14). The tone of the first lexeme changes according to that of the second, whereas the tone of the second lexeme remains basically the same. For instance, the tone value Ying Ping 533 will change to Yang Qu 11, when it meets with another Ying Ping 533, as in the case of hi533 ‘fly’ to hi11-ki533 ‘fly-machine’ or ‘plane’ || In the majority of cases, each morpheme has a ‘combination tone’ (a tone occurs in combination with the following full tone, e.g. sandhi tone) or an ‘isolation tone’ (a tone that occurs in isolation or is followed by an unstressed tone).
world_status: statement found in an open source

new_statements.rule_in_words: No rule for word-stress placement is given by any description opened. Puxian is described purely as a tone language: seven lexical tones (Putian 533, 13, 453, 42, 11, 21, 4), with two-syllable tone sandhi in which the first syllable changes and the second keeps its citation tone; the second syllable's initial undergoes mutation. Wu's only reference to stress is that a morpheme keeps its isolation tone when 'followed by an unstressed tone', i.e. neutral-tone/unstressed syllables exist, but which syllables they are is not stated.
new_statements.exceptions: None stated for stress. For tone: 阳入 has an old-style colloquial 35 reading merging with 阳平 (莆田市志 F06; 方言志); Xianyou values differ from Putian.
new_statements.domain_note: Statements concern lexical tone on isolated syllables and sandhi in two-syllable compounds/phrases (词/词组); no phrase-level prominence or citation-form stress is discussed. The gazetteers 莆田市志 2001 (卷四十三 方言, all 97 page scan scanned-searched) and 福建省志·方言志 1998 (第三章 莆仙方言, sandhi text + tables) and the instrumental thesis Chen 2014 are entirely silent on 轻声/重音/stress.
new_statements.identity_note: Wu 2010's corpus was recorded in Licheng (鲤城), the county seat of Xianyou (仙游), the author's native town, while his phonology table follows Putian-based descriptions (Cai 2006; Putian tone values 533/24/453/42/11/21/4). Chen 2014 describes Putian city (莆田市区) speech; Chen Hong 2018 describes Xianyou county; the gazetteers take 莆田城关话 as representative and give Xianyou values alongside. Glottolog puxi1243 has no separate codes for the Putian and Xianyou dialects, so all of these fall under puxi1243.

tone_statements.quote: 本論文では、ピッチを基準に莆仙方言には 5 つの声調があると主張したい。... 第 1 声調（陰平）は、高平調で音韻論的には/55/と記す。... 第 2 声調（陽平・陽入）は、上升調である。... 合わせて音韻的には/24/とまとめれば良いと考えられる。... 第 3 声調（陰上）は複雑である。... 音韻表記としては、/33/で良いと思う。第 4 声調（陰去）のピッチは、高いところから急に低いところに下がる。... 筆者は/51/で表記する。第 5 声調（陰去・陰入）のピッチは、低くてやや下がる。... 音韻論的には/11/と記す。 ... 莆仙方言では、いくつかの例外の語があるが、基本的に前部要素が変調をする。
tone_statements.translation: In this thesis I argue, on the basis of pitch, that Puxian has five tones. ... Tone 1 (yin ping) is a high level tone, written phonologically /55/. ... Tone 2 (yang ping / yang ru) is a rising tone ... taken together it can be summarised phonologically as /24/. ... Tone 3 (yin shang) is complex ... /33/ will do as its phonological notation. Tone 4 (yin qu) falls abruptly from high to low pitch ... I write it /51/. Tone 5 (yin qu [sic, = yang qu] / yin ru) is low and slightly falling ... phonologically I write /11/. ... In Puxian, apart from a few exceptional words, it is basically the first element (of a disyllable) that undergoes tone sandhi.

tone_statements.quote: 根据本次研究所得的数据，将新加坡兴化话单字调分为以下七种：阴平544（降平调）、阳平34（升调）、上声42（降调）、阴去51（高降调）、阳去21（低降调）、阴入21（低降促声调）、阳入43（高降促声调）。连读变调的规则是前字变调非常多见，而后字基本没有变调。
tone_statements.translation: On the data of this study the citation tones of Singapore Henghua fall into seven: yin-ping 544 (falling-level), yang-ping 34 (rising), shang 42 (falling), yin-qu 51 (high falling), yang-qu 21 (low falling), yin-ru 21 (low falling checked), yang-ru 43 (high falling checked). The sandhi rule is that tone change on the first syllable is very common while the second syllable basically does not change.
tone_statements.summary: Seven citation tones 544/34/42/51/21/21(checked)/43(checked) in diaspora (Singapore) Hinghwa; first-syllable sandhi, final syllable stable; nothing on stress in the abstract.

tone_statements.quote: 研究结果表明荔城方言的阴平调值为533、阳平为26、上声为453、阴去为42、阳去为14、阴入为21、阳入为4。存在49(7*7)种不同的连字变调规律。
tone_statements.translation: The results show that in the Licheng dialect the value of yin-ping is 533, yang-ping 26, shang 453, yin-qu 42, yang-qu 14, yin-ru 21 and yang-ru 4. There are 49 (7x7) distinct tone-sandhi patterns in connected two-syllable sequences.
tone_statements.summary: Seven citation tones for urban (Licheng) Putian with acoustic five-degree values 533/26/453/42/14/21/4 (cf. catalog values after Cai 2006: 533/24/453/42/11/21/4) and a full 7x7 disyllabic sandhi grid; nothing on stress in the abstract.

tone_statements.citation: 蔡寰宸 [Cai Huanchen]. 2020. 莆仙话双字调的声学分析 [An acoustic analysis of disyllabic tones in Puxian]. Preprint, 中国科学院科技论文预发布平台 ChinaXiv:202011.00042V1 (submitted 2020-11-10; 北京大学中国语言文学系), 12 pp. CSTR:32003.36.ChinaXiv.202011.00042.V1 (the DOI 10.12074/202011.00042 printed on the record is not registered at doi.org). Open mirror: Internet Archive item ChinaXiv-202011.00042V1.
tone_statements.quote: 莆仙话阴上、阳上两调归入上声，因此共有七个单字调。本文通过实验语音学方法，借助Praat软件重新测量了莆田涵江地区的莆仙话单字调，并在此基础上进行了双音节变调的分析，总结出变调规则。莆仙话的双字组变调只发生在前一音节，后一音节有可能发生变声，即声母变化（类化）。二字连读有三种情况，即保持原调、变为他调、产生高平调。
tone_statements.translation: In Puxian the yin-shang and yang-shang tones have merged into shang, so there are seven citation tones in all. Using experimental-phonetic methods and Praat, this paper re-measures the citation tones of the Puxian of the Hanjiang area of Putian and on that basis analyses disyllabic tone sandhi and states the sandhi rules. In Puxian disyllables sandhi occurs only on the first syllable; the second syllable may instead undergo a change of initial (assimilation). Two-syllable sequences show three cases: the original tone is kept, it changes to another tone, or a high level tone arises.
tone_statements.summary: Seven citation tones (Hanjiang Putian), values measured acoustically (not given in the abstract); left-syllable (first-position) sandhi only, with kept / changed / new high-level (44, 55) outcomes and a 阴入-阳入 value swap that preserves the glottal-stop coda; nothing on stress in the abstract.

sources.quote: 莆仙话阴上、阳上两调归入上声，因此共有七个单字调。本文通过实验语音学方法，借助Praat软件重新测量了莆田涵江地区的莆仙话单字调，并在此基础上进行了双音节变调的分析，总结出变调规则。莆仙话的双字组变调只发生在前一音节，后一音节有可能发生变声，即声母变化（类化）。二字连读有三种情况，即保持原调、变为他调、产生高平调。

tone.translation: In Puxian the yin-shang and yang-shang tones have merged into shang, so there are seven citation tones in all. Using experimental-phonetic methods and Praat, this paper re-measures the citation tones of the Puxian of the Hanjiang area of Putian and on that basis analyses disyllabic tone sandhi and states the sandhi rules. In Puxian disyllables sandhi occurs only on the first syllable; the second syllable may instead undergo a change of initial (assimilation). Two-syllable sequences show three cases: the original tone is kept, it changes to another tone, or a high level tone arises.
tone.summary: Seven citation tones (Hanjiang Putian), values measured acoustically (not given in the abstract); left-syllable (first-position) sandhi only, with kept / changed / new high-level (44, 55) outcomes and a 阴入-阳入 value swap that preserves the glottal-stop coda; nothing on stress in the abstract.
